title: Subtitling Arabic Cultural References into English: The Case of Brando el Sharq
core_idea: A descriptive study examining the challenges of subtitling cultural references from Lebanese Arabic into English in the ten-episode series Brando el Sharq. The study analyzes subtitling decisions and strategies using a seven-strategy taxonomy (direct translation, generalization, retention, substitution, specification, official equivalence, omission), collects and interprets data within relevant literature, and aims to assess the framework's sufficiency and identify any additional strategies or mistranslation issues.
tldr: Analyzes how cultural references in Lebanese Arabic are rendered into English subtitles for Brando el Sharq, using a seven-strategy taxonomy to examine subtitling challenges and the adequacy of existing strategies.
